  --nuget-owner NUGET_OWNER

  --pypi-packages PYPI_PACKAGES
                        comma-separated PyPI project names to count (default:
                        PyPI skipped)
  --data DATA           data folder, relative to the settings folder (default:
                        data)
  --top TOP             rows per summary table (default: 10)
  --config CONFIG       settings file (default: repo_traffic.json in the

  --version             show program's version number and exit
